app.title: Ghosted
app.subtitle: Find out who doesn't follow you back on Instagram
app.disclaimer: Your credentials are used only for this session and are never written to disk. Using this tool may violate Instagram's Terms of Service; use it at your own discretion and in moderation.
about.header: ℹ️ What is this and how do I use it?
about.purpose: **Purpose:** Ghosted is an educational project. It exists to show, hands-on, how a real automation against an undocumented private API actually works (2FA quirks, device fingerprinting, rate-limiting) and how to handle sessions/credentials with reasonable security practices. It isn't meant as a product for mass or recurring use.
about.what_it_does: **What it does:** compares who you follow on Instagram against who follows you back, and shows the difference — accounts you follow that don't follow you. From there you can filter them, export them, or unfollow the ones you pick, with pauses between actions so it doesn't look like a bot.
about.how_to_use:
**How to use it:**
1. Log in (username/password, or session cookie — see below for why the cookie is the recommended option).
2. Tap "Scan followers" and wait for it to finish.
3. Review the results: search, filter, mark accounts to ignore (whitelist) or to unfollow.
4. If you're unfollowing accounts, confirm and wait — the pauses are intentional, don't rush them.
about.credentials_warning: **About your password and the session cookie:** both are, in practice, a full key to your Instagram account. Never share either, or paste them into sites you don't trust — not even educational tools like this one. If you use cookie login, delete it from wherever you exported it as soon as you're done, and consider logging out that session from Instagram's own security settings. This app only keeps them in memory during your browser session and never writes them to disk, but that doesn't protect you from pasting them in the wrong place yourself.
login.2fa.legacy_unsupported: Instagram put this account on an older verification flow that this app can't direct to SMS or WhatsApp automatically. If you have an authenticator app or a backup code for this account, enter it above.
login.method.label: Login method
login.cookie.help: Skips 2FA entirely by reusing a session your browser already has. Log into instagram.com normally, then use a cookie-export extension (e.g. EditThisCookie, Cookie-Editor) on that tab to export the cookies for instagram.com, and paste the result below - you don't need to find or edit anything inside it, the app looks for the piece it needs on its own.
login.cookie.danger: ⚠️ That exported value is a live key to your account, equivalent to your password — anyone who has it can act as you on Instagram without ever entering a code. Never paste it anywhere you don't fully trust, and once you're done with this tool, delete it from wherever you exported it to (and consider logging out that browser session from Instagram's own security settings, which invalidates it).
login.cookie.label: Paste the exported cookies (or just the sessionid value)
login.cookie.error.not_found: Couldn't find a "sessionid" cookie in what you pasted. Make sure you exported the cookies for instagram.com while logged in.
login.cookie.error.invalid: That session looks invalid or expired. Export the cookies again from a fresh instagram.com tab.
login.error.challenge: Instagram requested extra verification (security checkpoint). Log in from the official app or website to clear it, then try again here.
scan.sleeping: Pausing {seconds}s to avoid temporary Instagram blocks
scan.done: Scan complete: you follow {following} accounts, {non_followers} don't follow you back.
scan.partial: Scan interrupted after checking {following} accounts you follow ({error}). Showing partial results - some non-followers may be missing.
unfollow.confirm: You're about to unfollow {count} accounts with pauses in between. Confirm?
unfollow.sleeping: Pausing {minutes} minutes every {batch} unfollows to avoid temporary blocks
whitelist.clear.confirm: Clear the entire whitelist? This cannot be undone.
